entries.headline: Four coded broadcasts and six specialist aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour and six specialised military aircraft airborne over the United States, including a nuclear command aircraft and a surveillance aircraft.

entries.headline: USAF MC-130J reported flying circuits near King’s Lynn
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force MC-130J-30 Commando II registration 13-5786 flying circuits east of King’s Lynn after departing RAF Mildenhall, attributing the sighting to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: US transports and elevated Baltic activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport and surveillance aircraft over the continental United States, Baltic-region air activity at four times its stated normal level, and one coded radio broadcast. The visible post is truncated after that point.

entries.headline: Six US military aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six significant US military aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including a bomber and a reconnaissance aircraft.

entries.headline: US transports, drones and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US military transport aircraft, surveillance drones and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with coded US Air Force radio broadcasts detected several times during the day. The visible post is truncated after that point.

entries.headline: Six major US military aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six major US military aircraft over the continental United States, including a nuclear command aircraft and a surveillance aircraft the account described as monitoring missile activity.

entries.headline: Five US transports and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command-and-control aircraft airborne over the United States, with no coded radio broadcasts detected during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six US transports and renewed Ukraine strikes reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States, a nuclear command-and-control aircraft spotted earlier, and Ukrainian reports of fresh missile strikes on major cities.

entries.headline: Six heavy transports and specialist aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft over the North Atlantic and continental United States, with a nuclear command aircraft and special reconnaissance aircraft spotted earlier. The visible post is truncated after that point.

entries.headline: Elevated Black Sea air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported military air activity over the Black Sea at nearly three times its stated normal level, alongside a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft and several transport aircraft airborne during the day.

entries.headline: Transport, command and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport and command aircraft across the Atlantic and North Sea and 11 coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: Heavy US transport activity reported near North Sea and Baltic
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force heavy-lift cargo aircraft over the North Sea and Baltic and characterised the activity as unusually high amid tensions concerning Ukraine.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on proposed Mach 4 SR-71 modification
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The War Zone report discussing whether an SR-71 Blackbird could be modified with modern engine technology to reach Mach 4. The post presents the idea as speculative.
